mechanism_narrative: RETAIL_REC has stabilized at -20.4% over the last two weeks after a steep decline from -38.6% three weeks ago. This plateau signals that the floor of retail demand has been reached and mean reversion will drive RETAIL_REC higher over the next four weeks as suppressed demand releases.
evidence_refs: fact:RETAIL_REC declined 18.2 points from t-3w to t-2w, then only 8.6 points from t-2w to t-1w, then stabilized at -20.4% at t-0w
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days remains below -15% or continues to decline week-on-week for three consecutive weeks.

mechanism_narrative: GROCERY_PHARM has recovered from -15.4% to +4.1% over three weeks, indicating restored confidence in essential shopping and public space safety. This behavioral shift toward normalcy will extend to discretionary retail, lifting RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks as the same confidence applies across place categories.
candidate_trigger: GROCERY_PHARM crosses above 0% and remains positive for two consecutive weeks
evidence_refs: fact:GROCERY_PHARM rose 10.1 points from t-3w to t-0w, crossing zero at t-1w
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days does not increase relative to the last 28 days, or GROCERY_PHARM falls below 0% within two weeks.

Increased transit access directly enables retail visits by lowering travel friction, driving RETAIL_REC higher over the next four weeks as transit-dependent populations resume shopping.

failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 14 days does not increase relative to the prior 14 days, or TRANSIT falls below -10% within one week.

This sustained workplace absence will constrain RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks because reduced workplace presence eliminates weekday commute-adjacent retail visits and reduces daytime foot traffic.

failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days increases by more than 5 percentage points relative to the last 28 days, or WORKPLACES rises above -15% within two weeks.

failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days increases by more than 8 percentage points, or both PARKS and RESIDENTIAL show sustained increases above 5% for two consecutive weeks.

failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days increases by more than 10 percentage points, or WORKPLACES rises above -15% within two weeks.
